meta.task: Bank customer churn, binary classification (1 = churned)
meta.data: Public bank customer churn dataset as cleaned by the ChurnGuard team for UTD FinHack 2024 (Cleaned_Modelling.csv)
handling: No missing values, no duplicate rows, no duplicate customer ids found; all rows kept.

Negative balances (likely overdrafts) in 42 rows kept as-is (per column: {'current_balance': 15, 'previous_month_end_balance': 11, 'average_monthly_balance_prevQ2': 23, 'current_month_balance': 7, 'previous_month_balance': 4}); heavy right tails kept (trees are invariant to monotone scaling).

days_since_last_transaction recomputed from last_transaction as days before the latest date in the data (2023-12-31); the CSV's version was measured from the date the team ran their notebook (offset of 97 days).
3 rows dated 2018-12-31 shifted by +4 years to match the team's 2019->2023 year rewrite (they would otherwise read 1826+ days).
No class reweighting or resampling: probabilities are calibrated to the natural base rate.
Identifier columns (customer_id, branch_code) are not used in the shipped model.
meta.selection: 5-fold stratified CV (shuffled, seed 42) log-loss on the training split; ship A unless B beats A by > 0.010 CV ROC-AUC
meta.threshold_encoding: shortest decimal t' such that float32(x) <= t' iff float32(x) <= t for every float32 x (exact; leaf-index equality verified)
meta.thresholds_rule: predicted positive when p >= t; rows are [t, tp, fp, fn, tn] on the test split
meta.calibration_rule: 10 equal-count bins of the test split sorted by p; rows are [mean_predicted, observed_rate, n]
meta.inference: raw = init + lr * sum(leaf values); p = sigmoid(raw). Cast inputs to float32 before comparing; go left when x[f] <= t.

features.label: Balance at end of last month
